title: ononis pubescens subsp. paniculata
intro: Ononis pubescens subsp. paniculata, commonly known as the hairy restharrow, is a perennial plant species in the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory effects. The hairy restharrow has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections.
